description: The retry is back: a stray signal makes the poll loop call connect again, and the second connect answers ISCONN
old: /\ UNCHANGED vars                 \* nothing yet, wait again
new:
/\ calls' = calls + 1
          /\ th' = "done"
          /\ res' = "fail"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, cancel, cancelAt>>

description: SO_ERROR is not read: a refused connect is reported connected
old:
/\ th' = "done"
          /\ res' = IF sock = "connected" THEN "ok" ELSE "fail"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, calls, cancel, cancelAt>>

\* The worker is done
new:
/\ th' = "done"
          /\ res' = "ok"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, calls, cancel, cancelAt>>

\* The worker is done

description: Cancel is ignored while the connect waits for the socket to be writable: it can still end connected
The first connect is issued twice
A canceled connect is reported failed
old:
/\ res' = "canceled"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, calls, cancel, cancelAt>>
       \/ /\ ~cancel
          /\ sock = "connecting"
new:
/\ res' = "fail"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, calls, cancel, cancelAt>>
       \/ /\ ~cancel
          /\ sock = "connecting"

description: A connect is reported canceled when nobody canceled it (a stray signal read as a cancel)
old: /\ UNCHANGED vars                 \* nothing yet, wait again
new:
/\ th' = "done"
          /\ res' = "canceled"
          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, calls, cancel, cancelAt>>
